patterns.formula: S + ແມ່ນ + N / Adj + ແລ້ວ

en.meaning: confirms that something is indeed the case or already happened
en.how: Use ແມ່ນ to affirm identity or truth, and ແລ້ວ at the end to show completion or agreement: 'Yes, that is already true / It is indeed so.'
en.note: To negate, use ບໍ່ແມ່ນ.

lo.meaning: ຢືນຢັນວ່າຖືກຕ້ອງ ຫຼື ເປັນແນວນັ້ນແລ້ວ

zh.meaning: 确实是这样 / 已经…了

mistake.wrong: ຂ້ອຍແມ່ນນັກຮຽນບໍແມ່ນແລ້ວ
mistake.right: ຂ້ອຍແມ່ນນັກຮຽນແລ້ວ

tr.en: Don't combine question ບໍ with affirmation ແລ້ວ in the same clause.

examples.zh: ແມ່ນແລ້ວ, ຂ້ອຍແມ່ນຄົນລາວ.
examples.py: Mâaen lɛ̂ɛo, khɔ̀ɔi mâaen khon láao.

tr.en: That's right, I am Lao.

examples.zh: ອັນນີ້ແມ່ນຂອງຂ້ອຍແລ້ວ.
examples.py: An nîi mâaen khɔ̌ɔng khɔ̀ɔi lɛ̂ɛo.

tr.en: This is already mine.

gen.zh: {P} ແມ່ນ {OCC} ແລ້ວ .
ອັນນີ້ ແມ່ນ {O} ຂອງ {P} .

en.meaning: standard negative construction: 'do not / is not'
en.how: Place ບໍ່ directly before the verb or adjective you want to negate. In Lao, verbs do not change form.
en.note: For 'is not a [noun]', use ບໍ່ແມ່ນ.

lo.meaning: ປະຕິເສດການກະທຳ ຫຼື ຄຸນລັກສະນະ (ບໍ່ + ກິລິຍາ/ຄຸນນາມ)

zh.meaning: 否定句 (不 + 动词/形容词)

mistake.wrong: ຂ້ອຍກິນບໍ່ເຂົ້າ
mistake.right: ຂ້ອຍບໍ່ກິນເຂົ້າ

tr.en: ບໍ່ goes before the verb (ກິນ), not after it.

examples.zh: ຂ້ອຍບໍ່ກິນຊີ້ນ.

tr.en: I don't eat meat.

examples.zh: ມື້ນີ້ລາວບໍ່ສະບາຍ.

tr.en: Today he is not well.

en.meaning: forms a yes/no question at the end of a sentence
en.how: Add ບໍ (or ບໍ່) to the end of any statement to turn it into a question, exactly like '吗' in Chinese or 'right?' in English.
en.note: Respond with the verb to agree, or ບໍ່ + verb to disagree.

lo.meaning: ສ້າງປະໂຫຍກຄຳຖາມ ແມ່ນ/ບໍ່ແມ່ນ ໂດຍໃສ່ ບໍ? ທ້າຍປະໂຫຍກ

mistake.wrong: ບໍເຈົ້າສະບາຍດີ?
mistake.right: ເຈົ້າສະບາຍດີບໍ?

tr.en: ບໍ goes at the end of the sentence, never at the beginning.

examples.zh: ເຈົ້າສະບາຍດີບໍ?

tr.en: How are you? / Are you well?

examples.zh: ອາຫານລາວແຊບບໍ?

tr.en: Is Lao food delicious?

gen.zh: {P} ມັກ {FOOD} ບໍ ?
{P} ຈະ ໄປ {PLACE} ບໍ ?
{NA} ແພງ ບໍ ?

en.meaning: expresses the desire to do an action: 'want to...'
en.how: Place ຢາກ directly before the verb. When you want a noun (object), use ຢາກໄດ້ or ຕ້ອງການ.
en.note: To say 'do not want to', use ບໍ່ຢາກ + V.

lo.meaning: ສະແດງຄວາມຕ້ອງການຢາກກະທຳສິ່ງໃດສິ່ງໜຶ່ງ (ຢາກ + ກິລິຍາ)

mistake.wrong: ຂ້ອຍຢາກນ້ຳ
mistake.right: ຂ້ອຍຢາກດື່ມນ້ຳ

tr.en: ຢາກ needs a verb after it: ຢາກດື່ມນ້ຳ (want to drink water), or use ຢາກໄດ້ນ້ຳ.

examples.zh: ຂ້ອຍຢາກກິນເຂົ້າໜຽວ.

tr.en: I want to eat sticky rice.

examples.zh: ເຈົ້າຢາກໄປໃສ?

tr.en: Where do you want to go?

gen.zh: {P} ຢາກ ກິນ {FOOD} .
{P} ຢາກ ດື່ມ {DRINK} .
{P} ຢາກ ໄປ ທ່ຽວ {CITY} .

patterns.formula: S + ກຳລັງ + V + (O) + (ຢູ່)

en.meaning: marks continuous or progressive action: 'in the middle of doing'
en.how: Put ກຳລັງ before the verb and optionally ຢູ່ at the end of the clause. In informal spoken Lao, either word alone can mark progress.
en.note: Similar to '正在…呢' in Chinese or '-ing' in English.

lo.meaning: ບອກການກະທຳທີ່ກຳລັງດຳເນີນຢູ່

examples.zh: ຂ້ອຍກຳລັງຮຽນພາສາລາວຢູ່.
examples.py: Khɔ̀ɔi kam-lang híian phāa-sǎa láao yùu.

tr.en: I am currently studying Lao language.

examples.zh: ລາວກຳລັງກິນເຂົ້າຢູ່.

tr.en: He is currently eating.

gen.zh: {P} ກຳລັງ {V} {O} ຢູ່ .
{P} ກຳລັງ ເຮັດວຽກ ຢູ່ {PLACE} .

patterns.formula: S + (ໄດ້) + V + O + ແລ້ວ

en.meaning: expresses past completion or finished actions
en.how: Place ແລ້ວ at the end of the action clause to show it is finished. You can optionally add ໄດ້ before the verb for extra emphasis on past occurrence.
en.note: Negate with ຍັງບໍ່ໄດ້ (haven't yet).

lo.meaning: ບອກວ່າການກະທຳນັ້ນໄດ້ເກີດຂຶ້ນ ແລະ ສຳເລັດແລ້ວ

examples.zh: ຂ້ອຍກິນເຂົ້າແລ້ວ.

tr.en: I have already eaten.

examples.zh: ລາວໄດ້ໄປວຽງຈັນແລ້ວ.

tr.en: She has already gone to Vientiane.

gen.zh: {P} ໄດ້ {V} {O} ແລ້ວ .
{P} ໄປ {CITY} ມາ ແລ້ວ .

patterns.formula: A + Adj + ກວ່າ + B

en.meaning: comparative adjective: 'A is more [Adj] than B'
en.how: In Lao, the adjective comes before ກວ່າ: 'A [Adj] than B'. For example, ໃຫຍ່ກວ່າ means 'bigger than'.
en.note: To say 'the most / best', use ທີ່ສຸດ (thii-sut) after the adjective.

lo.meaning: ປຽບທຽບຂັ້ນກວ່າ (A + ຄຸນນາມ + ກວ່າ + B)

mistake.wrong: ວຽງຈັນກວ່າໃຫຍ່ຫຼວງພະບາງ
mistake.right: ວຽງຈັນໃຫຍ່ກວ່າຫຼວງພະບາງ

tr.en: The adjective (ໃຫຍ່) comes before ກວ່າ.

examples.zh: ວຽງຈັນໃຫຍ່ກວ່າຫຼວງພະບາງ.

tr.en: Vientiane is bigger than Luang Prabang.

examples.zh: ເບຍລາວແຊບກວ່າມື້ວານນີ້.
examples.py: Bīa láao sàaep gwaa mɯ̂ɯ wāan nîi.

tr.en: Beerlao tastes even better than yesterday.

gen.zh: {CITY} {A} ກວ່າ {CITY2} .
ອາຫານ ນີ້ {A} ກວ່າ .

patterns.formula: ຖ້າ + Condition ， (S) + ກໍ + Result

en.how: Open the condition with ຖ້າ (if), and introduce the consequence with ກໍ (then) before the main verb.
en.note: In conversational Lao, ຖ້າວ່າ is also very common.

lo.meaning: ສົມມຸດຕິຖານ (ຖ້າຫາກວ່າ…ກໍຈະ…)

examples.zh: ຖ້າມື້ອື່ນຝົນຕົກ, ພວກເຮົາກໍຈະບໍ່ໄປ.
examples.py: Thâa mɯ̂ɯ ɯ̀ɯn fǒn dtók, phùak-háo gɔɔ ja bɔ̀ɔ pái.

tr.en: If it rains tomorrow, then we will not go.

examples.zh: ຖ້າເຈົ້າມີເວລາ, ມາເຮືອນຂ້ອຍເດີ.
examples.py: Thâa jâo mīi wēe-lāa, māa hɯ́an khɔ̀ɔi də̂ə.

tr.en: If you have time, come over to my place.

gen.zh: ຖ້າ {P} ມີ ເວລາ , {P} ກໍ ຈະ {V} .
ຖ້າ ລາຄາ ບໍ່ {A} , ຂ້ອຍ ກໍ ຈະ ຊື້ .
gen.en: If the price is not too {A.e}, I will buy it.

patterns.hz: ຍ້ອນວ່າ…ຈຶ່ງ…
patterns.formula: ຍ້ອນວ່າ + Reason ， S + ຈຶ່ງ + Result

en.how: ຍ້ອນວ່າ introduces the reason, and ຈຶ່ງ precedes the verb in the result clause: 'Because A happened, therefore B.'
en.note: In speech, ຍ້ອນ alone can replace ຍ້ອນວ່າ.

lo.meaning: ບອກສາເຫດ ແລະ ຜົນຮັບ (ຍ້ອນວ່າ…ສະນັ້ນຈຶ່ງ…)

examples.zh: ຍ້ອນວ່າລາວບໍ່ສະບາຍ, ລາວຈຶ່ງບໍ່ມາຮຽນ.
examples.py: Nyɔ̂ɔn-wâa láao bɔ̀ɔ sà-bāai, láao jɯ̀ng bɔ̀ɔ māa híian.

tr.en: Because he is not well, he therefore didn't come to school.

gen.zh: ຍ້ອນວ່າ {P} ມັກ {FOOD} , {P} ຈຶ່ງ ກິນ ຫຼາຍ .

patterns.formula: ທັງ + Adj/V + ທັງ + Adj/V

en.meaning: expresses two qualities or actions existing at once: 'both...and...'
en.how: Place ທັງ before each adjective or verb. Example: ທັງຖືກທັງແຊບ (both cheap and delicious).
en.note: Both attributes should share the same positive or negative tone.

lo.meaning: ມີສອງລັກສະນະ ຫຼື ເຮັດສອງຢ່າງພ້ອມກັນ (ທັງ…ທັງ…)

examples.zh: ຮ້ານນີ້ອາຫານທັງຖືກທັງແຊບ.
examples.py: Hâan nîi āa-hǎan thang thɯ̀ɯk thang sàaep.

tr.en: At this restaurant, the food is both cheap and delicious.

gen.zh: {FOOD} ນີ້ ທັງ {A} ທັງ {B} .

title.lo: ການທັກທາຍ ແລະ ແນະນຳຕົວ

desc.en: Master essential Lao greetings: Sabaidee, thank you, names, polite particles, and asking how someone is.
desc.lo: ຮຽນຮູ້ຄຳທັກທາຍພື້ນຖານ ສະບາຍດີ, ຂອບໃຈ, ການຖາມຊື່ ແລະ ຄວາມສຸພາບ.

words: ບໍ່ເປັນຫຍັງ

title.lo: ອາຫານລາວ ແລະ ວັດທະນະທຳເຂົ້າໜຽວ

desc.en: Explore famous Lao dishes: khao niao, laap, tam mak hoong, Lao coffee, and how to express deliciousness.
desc.lo: ອາຫານລາວຍອດນິຍົມ ເຂົ້າໜຽວ, ລາບ, ຕຳໝາກຫຸ່ງ, ກາເຟລາວ ແລະ ຄຳວ່າແຊບ.

title.lo: ຊື້ເຄື່ອງຢູ່ຕະຫຼາດເຊົ້າ ແລະ ຕໍ່ລອງລາຄາ

desc.en: Numbers, prices in Kip, asking 'how much?', and politely asking for a discount.
desc.lo: ການຖາມລາຄາ, ຕົວເລກເງິນກີບ ແລະ ການຂໍຫຼຸດລາຄາ.

title.lo: ໂຄງສ້າງປະໂຫຍກພາສາລາວ (ປະທານ + ກິລິຍາ + ກຳ)

body.en: Lao is an analytic SVO (Subject - Verb - Object) language. Verbs never change or conjugate for tense, person, or number. Modifiers (adjectives and possessives) always follow the noun: e.g. ອາຫານແຊບ (food delicious = delicious food), ເຮືອນຂ້ອຍ (house me = my house).
body.lo: ພາສາລາວມີໂຄງສ້າງຫຼັກ ປະທານ + ກິລິຍາ + ກຳ. ຄຳກິລິຍາບໍ່ມີການປ່ຽນຮູບ. ຄຳຄຸນນາມ ແລະ ຄຳຂະຫຍາຍຈະຢູ່ດ້ານຫຼັງຄຳນາມສະເໝີ ເຊັ່ນ: ອາຫານແຊບ, ລົດໃໝ່, ເຮືອນຂອງຂ້ອຍ.

examples.zh: ຂ້ອຍຮຽນພາສາລາວ.

tr.en: I study Lao language.

examples.zh: ລາວມັກອາຫານລາວ.

tr.en: He likes Lao food.

title.en: Lao Classifiers (ລັກສະນະນາມ)
title.lo: ລັກສະນະນາມໃນພາສາລາວ

body.en: In Lao, when counting nouns or pointing to them ('this/that'), you must use a classifier: [Noun] + [Number] + [Classifier], or [Noun] + [Classifier] + [ນີ້/ນັ້ນ]. Key classifiers: ໂຕ (animals, shirts, furniture), ຄົນ (people), ອັນ (small things), ຫົວ (books), ແກ້ວ (bottles), ຈອກ (cups).
body.lo: ລັກສະນະນາມໃຊ້ບອກໝວດໝູ່ສິ່ງຂອງ ເວລານັບຈຳນວນ ຫຼື ຊີ້ສະເພາະ ເຊັ່ນ: ປຶ້ມສອງຫົວ, ເບຍສາມແກ້ວ, ໝາໜຶ່ງໂຕ, ຄົນສອງຄົນ.

examples.zh: ຂໍເບຍລາວສອງແກ້ວ.

tr.en: Two bottles of Beerlao, please.

examples.zh: ລາວມີໝູ່ສາມຄົນ.

tr.en: She has three friends.

title.lo: ຄວາມສຸພາບໃນພາສາລາວ: ເຈົ້າ, ໂດຍ, ເດີ

body.en: Lao culture places deep emphasis on warmth and courtesy. 'ເຈົ້າ' (jao) is used as a polite 'yes' or acknowledgment. 'ໂດຍ' (doey) is formal and shows deep respect (used with elders, monks, officials). Sentence-ending particles like 'ເດີ' (de) soften statements warmly: ສະບາຍດີເດີ, ໂຊກດີເດີ (good luck!).
body.lo: ວັດທະນະທຳລາວເນັ້ນຄວາມອ່ອນຫວານສຸພາບ. ຄຳວ່າ 'ໂດຍ' ໃຊ້ຕອບຮັບຜູ້ໃຫຍ່ດ້ວຍຄວາມເຄົາລົບ, 'ເຈົ້າ' ໃຊ້ທົ່ວໄປ, ສ່ວນ 'ເດີ' ເຮັດໃຫ້ປະໂຫຍກອ່ອນໂຍນເປັນກັນເອງ.

examples.zh: ໂດຍ, ຂອບໃຈຫຼາຍໆ.

tr.en: Yes, thank you very much.

examples.zh: ພົບກັນໃໝ່ເດີ.

tr.en: See you again soon!

title.lo: ຢູ່ຮ້ານເຝີ

lines.zh: ສະບາຍດີ, ມີເຝີບໍ?

tr.en: Hello, do you have pho noodles?

lines.zh: ໂດຍ, ມີ. ເຈົ້າຢາກກິນເຝີງົວ ຫຼື ເຝີໄກ່?
lines.py: Dōoei, mīi. Jâo yàak kin fə̌ə ngúaa lɯ̌ɯ fə̌ə kái?

tr.en: Yes, we do. Would you like beef pho or chicken pho?

lines.zh: ຂໍເຝີງົວໜຶ່ງຖ້ວຍ ແລະ ນ້ຳດື່ມໜຶ່ງແກ້ວ.
lines.py: Khɔ̌ɔ fə̌ə ngúaa nɯ̀ng thùai lɛ́ nâm dɯ̀ɯm nɯ̀ng kɛ̂ɛo.

tr.en: One bowl of beef pho and one bottle of water, please.

lines.zh: ໂດຍ, ລໍຖ້າໜ້ອຍໜຶ່ງເດີ.
lines.py: Dōoei, lɔɔ thâa nɔ̂ɔi nɯ̀ng də̂ə.

tr.en: Certainly, please wait a moment.

title.lo: ຊື້ເສື້ອຢູ່ຕະຫຼາດເຊົ້າ

lines.zh: ສະບາຍດີ, ເສື້ອໂຕນີ້ລາຄາເທົ່າໃດ?
lines.py: Sà-bāai-dī, sɯ̂a dtōo nîi lāa-khāa thào-dài?

tr.en: Hello, how much is this shirt?

lines.zh: ແປດສິບພັນກີບເດີ.

tr.en: Eighty thousand Kip.

lines.zh: ແພງໜ້ອຍໜຶ່ງ, ຫຼຸດໄດ້ບໍ? ເຈັດສິບພັນໄດ້ບໍ?
lines.py: Pháaeng nɔ̂ɔi nɯ̀ng, lùt dài bɔ̀ɔ? Jét síp phán dài bɔ̀ɔ?

tr.en: A little bit expensive, can you discount? How about 70,000 Kip?

lines.zh: ໄດ້, ຂອບໃຈຫຼາຍໆເດີ!

tr.en: Can do! Thank you very much!

title.lo: ແບບທົດສອບຄຳທັກທາຍ
ແບບທົດສອບອາຫານລາວ

data.z: ສະຫວັນນະເຂດ
ຕະຫຼາດເຊົ້າ

title.lo: ພາສາລາວຂັ້ນພື້ນຖານ

desc.en: Start from zero: greetings, self-introductions, alphabet, and core conversational patterns.
desc.lo: ເລີ່ມຕົ້ນຈາກສູນ: ການທັກທາຍ, ອັກສອນ, ແລະ ຮູບແບບປະໂຫຍກພື້ນຖານ.

title.en: Welcome to LaoLao! (ສະບາຍດີ ລາວລາວ)
title.lo: ຍິນດີຕ້ອນຮັບສູ່ ລາວລາວ!

notes.en: Dedicated platform for mastering the Lao language: Lao script, phonetics, sentence patterns, audio pronunciation, stroke handwriting studio, dictionary, and quizzes.
notes.lo: ເວັບແອັບຮຽນພາສາລາວຢ່າງຄົບວົງຈອນ ພ້ອມສຽງ, ອັກສອນ, ໄວຍາກອນ, ວັດຈະນານຸກົມ ແລະ ແບບຝຶກຫັດ.
